messages:
evan: quick flag — docs PR #4281 failing snippet tests, looks like streaming paginate + retry changes. Can someone triage?

ci-bot: CI failed: docs-snippets (validator) — 3 errors
ci-bot: logs:
```
Error: deprecated 'backoff' param in examples/py/streaming/retries.md:12
Error: examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md uses sync iterator; paginator now returns AsyncGenerator
Error: examples/go/streaming/paginate.md uses InlineStream which was removed
```

rita: I'll take TS, will change `for (...)` -> `for await (...)` and add a short comment about the AsyncGenerator change.

sam: I'll handle Python — replace `backoff` with `retry_policy` and add a tiny compatibility helper: `# sync compat: run_sync(cursor)` so teams can search for old patterns.

lee: on Go, replace InlineStream -> StreamCursor, add `defer cur.Close()`, and shorten long comments to satisfy lint.

sam: pushed py patch and a migration blurb at the top of examples/py/streaming/paginate.md explaining StreamReader->StreamCursor + sync helper.

rita: pushed TS fix: updated loops to `for await (const p of paginate(...)) {}` and fixed an internal link to /docs/streaming/pagination; added missing newline in fenced block.

ci-bot: re-run started for PR #4281 (python, ts, go).

ci-bot: docs-snippets-python: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-ts: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-go: PASSED

docs-bot: Reminder: add changelog entry: "StreamCursor replaces InlineStream/StreamReader; paginate returns AsyncGenerator; retry param `backoff` renamed to `retry_policy`. See migration guide."

evan: Merged. Thanks all — leaving a follow-up on the docs board to monitor support channels for 48h.
